requiredBehaviors.behavior: record repository branch and immutable head SHA
requiredBehaviors.evidence: The handoff names the repository, base branch, working branch, clean working-tree state, and exact immutable head commit.

requiredBehaviors.behavior: separate verified facts decisions completed work and residual risks
requiredBehaviors.evidence: Facts cite evidence, accepted decisions are distinct, completed actions include commits and commands, and residual risks are listed separately.

requiredBehaviors.behavior: provide exactly one executable next action with expected evidence
requiredBehaviors.evidence: One prioritized action includes preconditions and the concrete evidence that will prove completion.

forbiddenBehaviors.behavior: repeat work already recorded as completed
forbiddenBehaviors.evidence: Completed actions are paired with do-not-repeat guidance.

forbiddenBehaviors.behavior: replace exact evidence with a vague narrative
forbiddenBehaviors.evidence: Commit SHAs, commands, references, and verification results remain explicit.
